changes.title: Touch every Custom Rules boundary
changes.text: Use native API34 touchscreen input to set all 18 controls to both limits, save, reopen and prove active-run rules and earned score stay locked.

changes.title: Keep first-column labels in plain-text exports
changes.text: Prefix every non-empty table header, including the first column, so all recorded Custom Rules fields remain identifiable outside rich table formats.

changes.title: Accept all recorded rule fields end to end
changes.text: Exercise every numeric operator, combined filters, details, comparison and all export formats while preserving historical unknowns and original scores.

changes.title: Record TEST217 and all-control evidence
changes.text: Preserve verified TEST217 evidence, the separate native acceptance result and the exact TEST218 gate against the immediate previous compiled APK.

commentary: I verified every Custom Dungeon Rules control through native touch and added end-to-end recorded-field acceptance. Plain-text exports now keep every column label. Gameplay, histories, saves, earned scores and all 18 values are unchanged.
